summary: Iteration 14 verified all 4 user requests: sidebar categorization, removal of Price List Supplier, manual income CRUD on Cashflow, xlsx export on Transactions, and sort selectors on Products/Inventory/Transactions/Cashflow. Backend pytest (4/4) passed: /api/incomes POST/GET/DELETE work with Bearer auth, unauthenticated returns 403, /api/cashflow/summary now returns total_income, total_income_sales, total_income_manual, total_expense, net_cashflow and a Rp 500k manual income correctly increases total_income_manual and net_cashflow by 500000. Frontend Playwright verified: sidebar groups UTAMA/KATALOG/KEUANGAN/SISTEM present, 'Price List Supplier' NOT in sidebar, /supplier-prices route unregistered (blank layout). Cashflow shows 4 summary cards + income-add + expense-add + cashflow-sort (4 options); creating QA_INCOME_TEST (Rp 250k, category Modal Awal) via UI renders in Pemasukan Manual list. Transactions has txn-export-excel that triggers real .xlsx download 'transaksi-2026-09-03.xlsx' starting with PK magic bytes; txn-sort has 5 options; Pelanggan column present; 'via WA' badge present. Products has product-sort with 6 options; Inventory has inv-sort with 4 options. Cleanup completed (1 QA_INCOME_TEST row deleted via API).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx: bottomMenu is built via hard-coded flat indexes (flat[0],[1],[2],[5],[8]). Fragile - any reorder of groups[] silently changes bottom nav. Prefer selecting by id (e.g. flat.find(x=>x.id==='transactions')).

cashflow-sort / txn-sort / product-sort / inv-sort are shadcn/radix Selects, not native <select>. Consider adding data-value attributes on SelectItem for easier test targeting (currently only innerText is available).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created 1 income Rp 250k (QA_INCOME_TEST) via UI and 1 income Rp 500k via API test; both cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sort selectors are radix Selects — use force-click on trigger then match [role='option'] items. xlsx download works and filename follows transaksi-YYYY-MM-DD.xlsx. /api/incomes CRUD stable.
